baslik: The Anchor Handler Pulled Over by Its Own Chain

sahneler.metin: An anchor handling vessel capsized in the North Sea.
It rolled over while working, and members of its crew were killed.
It was moving a heavy anchor chain for an oil rig.
The chain drifted off to the side.
Its enormous weight pulled the ship sideways.
Its new captain had only ninety minutes to take over.
An inquiry questioned whether ship and crew were ready for such deep water.

aciklama:
Bourbon Dolphin capsized while handling a rig's anchor. The cause: loss of stability from chain tension at a steep angle during anchor handling.

#shorts #engineering #maritime
